title: Prompting Fairness: Artificial Intelligence as Game Players

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating the dictator game and comparing the amount of money the AI allocates to a recipient when they are framed as being 'in need' versus a 'millionaire'.

Assigning the AI different role personas (an HR executive in a city vs. a Rancher in a rural area) to evaluate if job descriptions and implicit stereotypes affect its game playing strategy and level of altruism.
